description: Sound effects a 3D script may cue (files in assets/sfx/generated/, shared with the 2D engine).

pop.description: A bubbly pop (numbers and letters appearing).

flute_tune.description: A short gentle bamboo flute tune (2.5 s).

whale_song.description: A gentle whale call: a low tone gliding up and slowly back down, with a soft echo (2.4 s).

hum.description: A soft low hum that swells and fades: deep water, a purring machine, a sleepy hum (2.2 s).

foghorn.description: A distant lighthouse foghorn: two long, low, soft notes in the mist (2.5 s).

whoosh.description: A whoosh (camera moves, things flying in).

windup_click.description: A little ticking wind-up (thinking time before an answer).

fizz.description: A bubbly fizz (baking soda and vinegar).

twang.description: A plucked rubber band or string.

cha_ching.description: A shop till opening with a bright ring.

clink.description: A small metal clink (a paper clip jumping onto a magnet).

splash.description: Something drops into water: a thump and a spray (sink or float).

sad_sting.description: Three soft falling notes for a sad moment (kept gentle).

door_open.description: A creaky door or lid opening.

sneeze.description: A comic sneeze (healthy habits: cover your sneeze).

narrate_chime.description: A soft two-note chime for a new page or chapter.

ph_a_short.description: Letter sound /a/ as in apple: the soft voice saying the bare sound (engine3d/tools/phonemes.mjs).

ph_e_short.description: Letter sound /e/ as in egg: the soft voice saying the bare sound (engine3d/tools/phonemes.mjs).

ph_i_short.description: Letter sound /i/ as in itch: the soft voice saying the bare sound (engine3d/tools/phonemes.mjs).

ph_o_short.description: Letter sound /o/ as in octopus: the soft voice saying the bare sound (engine3d/tools/phonemes.mjs).

ph_u_short.description: Letter sound /u/ as in up: the soft voice saying the bare sound (engine3d/tools/phonemes.mjs).

ph_a_long.description: Letter sound long a, as in ape (also ai, ay, a_e): the soft voice saying the bare sound (engine3d/tools/phonemes.mjs).

ph_e_long.description: Letter sound long e, as in eel (also ee, ea): the soft voice saying the bare sound (engine3d/tools/phonemes.mjs).

ph_i_long.description: Letter sound long i, as in ice (also i_e, igh): the soft voice saying the bare sound (engine3d/tools/phonemes.mjs).

ph_o_long.description: Letter sound long o, as in oat (also oa, o_e): the soft voice saying the bare sound (engine3d/tools/phonemes.mjs).

ph_u_long.description: Letter sound long u, as in use (also u_e): the soft voice saying the bare sound (engine3d/tools/phonemes.mjs).

ph_oo.description: Letter sound /oo/ as in moon: the soft voice saying the bare sound (engine3d/tools/phonemes.mjs).

ph_ar.description: Letter sound /ar/ as in car (r-controlled vowel): the soft voice saying the bare sound (engine3d/tools/phonemes.mjs).

ph_er.description: Letter sound /er/ as in her, bird and turn (r-controlled vowel; er, ir and ur all say it): the soft voice saying the bare sound (engine3d/tools/phonemes.mjs).

ph_or.description: Letter sound /or/ as in fork (r-controlled vowel): the soft voice saying the bare sound (engine3d/tools/phonemes.mjs).

ph_b.description: Letter sound /b/ as in ball, clipped with no added uh: the soft voice saying the bare sound (engine3d/tools/phonemes.mjs).

ph_c.description: Letter sound hard c, as in cat (same sound as k): the soft voice saying the bare sound, cut before any vowel (no added uh) (engine3d/tools/phonemes.mjs).

ph_d.description: Letter sound /d/ as in dog: the soft voice saying the bare sound, cut before any vowel (no added uh) (engine3d/tools/phonemes.mjs).

ph_f.description: Letter sound /f/ as in fish (held): the soft voice saying the bare sound (engine3d/tools/phonemes.mjs).

ph_g.description: Letter sound hard g, as in goat: the soft voice saying the bare sound, cut before any vowel (no added uh) (engine3d/tools/phonemes.mjs).

ph_h.description: Letter sound /h/ as in hat: a soft breathed hhh with no vowel after it (made, not TTS: engine3d/tools/phonemes.mjs).

ph_j.description: Letter sound /j/ as in jam: the soft voice saying the bare sound, cut before any vowel (no added uh) (engine3d/tools/phonemes.mjs).

ph_k.description: Letter sound /k/ as in kite: the soft voice saying the bare sound, cut before any vowel (no added uh) (engine3d/tools/phonemes.mjs).

ph_n.description: Letter sound /n/ as in nest (held): the soft voice saying the bare sound (engine3d/tools/phonemes.mjs).

ph_p.description: Letter sound /p/ as in pig: the soft voice saying the bare sound, cut before any vowel (no added uh) (engine3d/tools/phonemes.mjs).

ph_qu.description: Letter sound /kw/ as in queen: the soft voice saying the bare sound (engine3d/tools/phonemes.mjs).

ph_r.description: Letter sound /r/ as in red (an "rrr"): the soft voice saying the bare sound (engine3d/tools/phonemes.mjs).

ph_s.description: Letter sound /s/ as in sun (held hiss): the soft voice saying the bare sound (engine3d/tools/phonemes.mjs).

ph_t.description: Letter sound /t/ as in top: the soft voice saying the bare sound, cut before any vowel (no added uh) (engine3d/tools/phonemes.mjs).

buzz.description: A soft, friendly bee buzz that wobbles as it flies by (bees, flowers, rhymes).

crack.description: A gentle eggshell crack: three small taps and a soft snap (an egg hatching).

timer_tick.description: A bright wood-block tick for each countdown number (3, 2, 1).

timer_chime.description: The timer ringing: a bright two-note bell.

wrong_soft.description: A gentle low boop-boop for a wrong answer (never scary).

listen_cue.description: A soft rising two-note cue: your turn, listen, say it.
